data.title: Man found shot dead after killing his girlfriend
data.description: NAKHON SI THAMMARAT - A man was found shot dead outside his home in Muang district of this southern province early Sunday morning, after allegedly killing his girlfriend on Friday.

data.title: Nakhon Phanom flooded, South on alert
data.description: NAKHON PHANOM - Overnight downpours left submerged roads and inundated homes and businesses in this northeastern border province on Sunday, prompting emergency drainage operations.

data.title: School closes classes after sacked foreign teacher’s threat
data.description: SONGKHLA - The management of Hatyaiwittayalai secondary school in this southern province announced it will close its gates on Monday and Tuesday and provide online lessons after a sacked foreign teacher posted a firearm threat.

data.title: School goes on-line after former foreign teacher’s threat
data.description: SONGKHLA: The management of Hatyaiwittayalai School in this southern province will close its gates on Monday and Tuesday and provide online services after a former foreign teacher posed a firearm threat.

data.title: Driver injures 20 kids
data.description: KANCHANABURI: Police have charged a 54-year-old driver with five offences after his car crashed into a child development centre in Muang district, injuring 20 children.

data.title: Amlo eyes 200 in exam fraud probe
data.description: The government has widened its local-government exam fraud probe, with the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) tracing the financial transactions of more than 200 people involved in the network.

data.title: Thai InterPride head urges global solidarity
data.description: InterPride's first Thai transgender co-president has warned that global LGBTQ+ rights are at a critical crossroads, urging solidarity against rising hatred.

data.title: Hospital graft claims 'unproven'
data.description: The Ministry of Public Health has rejected claims of widespread corruption involving health promotion and prevention funds at community hospitals.

data.title: Na Ladprao beer hall owner charged over fatal fire
data.description: Police have charged the owner of Na Ladprao beer hall with six offences following a fire last month that killed 37 people and injured 77 others.

data.title: Court halts delay of Social Security poll
data.description: The Central Administrative Court has ordered a temporary suspension of an announcement postponing the Social Security Board election, clearing the way for the poll to proceed until the court issues a final ruling.

data.title: No signs of bullying: witness
data.description: The public should avoid speculating that bullying had triggered the shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School in Nonthaburi's Bang Kruai district, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

data.title: TH-AI Passport launch clears final hurdle
data.description: The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society expects to launch the TH-AI Passport programme by Sept 1, after the Office of the Attorney General cleared the final legal hurdle for the nationwide AI initiative.

data.title: Thailand rejects UN envoy's report on Cambodia
data.description: Thailand has expressed deep disappointment with a recent United Nations report on Cambodia that criticised Thailand, saying it exceeded its mandate and lacked balance.

data.title: Govt speeds up rooftop solar scheme
data.description: The government is stepping up work on a rooftop solar scheme aimed at promoting clean energy and reducing household electricity costs.

data.title: Bullies at elite Bangkok private school face charges
data.description: Police in Bangkok have charged a group of students from Saint Gabriel’s College, one of the country’s most prestigious private schools, after they were seen threatening and hitting another boy with an airsoft gun.

data.title: Police hope witnesses can shed light on school shooting
data.description: Police are stepping up their investigation into the shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School, questioning teachers, students and witnesses as they seek to determine what motivated a 14-year-old boy to kill seven people before taking his own life on Friday.

data.title: E-waste alarm in Prachin Buri
data.description: Residents ask why it took more than a year to shut down plant operating in a reserved forest

data.title: Singapore PM to visit Thailand next month
data.description: Singapore's Prime Minister Lawrence Wong will visit Thailand next month for the first Singapore-Thailand Leaders' Retreat in more than a decade.

data.title: More free trade deals to boost Thai exports
data.description: The government has pledged to leverage free trade agreements (FTAs) to help Thai businesses integrate into global supply chains, expand export markets and attract investment.

data.title: Appointment of former Yingluck aide questioned
data.description: <p>Political activist Tul Sittisomwong has criticised the appointment of a former close aide to former prime minister Yingluck Shinawatra as director of the Strategic Transformation Office (STO).</p>

data.title: Government weighs second phase of co-payment scheme
data.description: The government will review its fiscal position before deciding whether to proceed with the second phase of the "Thais Help Thais Plus" co-payment scheme or revise its conditions.

data.title: 3,400 face the axe over exam fraud
data.description: More than 3,400 local-government officials face losing their jobs after authorities uncovered widespread score manipulation in a civil service examination, prompting the Interior Ministry to approve a new list of successful candidates.

data.title: More free trade deals to boost Thai exports
data.description: The government has pledged to leverage free trade agreements (FTAs) to help Thai businesses integrate into global supply chains, expand export markets and attract investment.

data.title: Meth treatment cost cut by herbal plan
data.description: A Thai herbal medicine programme could expand access to methamphetamine addiction treatment while reducing costs and improving recovery outcomes, according to a researcher at Thammasat University.

data.title: 4 Vietnamese held over scam network
data.description: Police arrested four Vietnamese nationals in Bangkok on Thursday after uncovering an alleged transnational network linked to call centre scams and drug trafficking.
